title: How turbulent flows grow vorticity at a point
summary: We describe how strong vorticity fluctuations appear in three-dimensional incompressible turbulence driven by a large-scale random force. By combining analytical and numerical methods, we construct a vorticity instanton: the most probable force history driving the flow to a prescribed large vorticity at a given point and time. We show how the smooth, large-scale force produces a long vortex filament with a thin, viscous-scale core.
